plain_english: By that quick filling, to the crown's end broken through, by the brow-toss bridge: thought-free mind made — above all, all go forth.
sanskrit_cite: tayāpūryāśu mūrdhāntaṃ bhaṅktvā bhrūkṣepasetunā | nirvikalpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā sarvordhve sarvagodgamaḥ

plain_english: With peacock feathers, with varied forms, with circles, in the five-void: of the meditating one, in the unsurpassed void, entry in the heart may be.
sanskrit_cite: śikhipakṣaiś citrarūpair ma.ṅdalaiḥ śūnyapañcakam | dhyāyato 'nuttare śūnye praveśo hṛdaye bhavet

plain_english: By just such course — wherever thought: in void, on the wall, on the supreme, on the vessel, self dissolved — the boon-giving.
sanskrit_cite: īdṛśena krameṇaiva yatra kutrāpi cintanā | śūnye kuḍye pare pātre svayaṃ līnā varapradā

plain_english: Inside the skull, mind placed; standing with eyes half closed: in order, from the mind's firmness, mark the to-be-marked — the highest.
sanskrit_cite: kapālāntar mano nyasya tiṣṭhan mīlitalocanaḥ | krameṇa manaso dārḍhyāt lakṣayet laṣyam uttamam

plain_english: Middle channel, standing in the middle, like a lotus-fiber; by the meditated inner sky, O Goddess — by that, god shines forth.
sanskrit_cite: madhyanāḍī madhyasaṃsthā bisasūtrābharūpayā | dhyātāntarvyomayā devyā tayā devaḥ prakāśate

plain_english: By the hand-blocked gaze-weapon, from the brow's splitting, from the door's blocking; when seen in the drop, in order, when dissolved — in that middle, the supreme standing.
sanskrit_cite: kararuddhadṛgastreṇa bhrūbhedād dvārarodhanāt | dṛṣṭe bindau kramāl līne tanmadhye paramā sthitiḥ

plain_english: The mark of subtle fire born of dwelling-inner-churn — the drop at the crest's end, in the heart, at dissolution's end: for the meditating one, dissolving.
sanskrit_cite: dhāmāntaḥkṣobhasambhūtasūkṣmāgnitilakākṛtim | binduṃ śikhānte hṛdaye layānte dhyāyato layaḥ

plain_english: In the unstruck, in the vessel-ear, in the broken sound, in the river's rushing; bathed in word-brahman, the supreme brahman is attained.
sanskrit_cite: anāhate pātrakarṇe 'bhagnaśabde sariddrute | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahmādhigacchati

plain_english: From the prolonged utterance of oṃ and the rest, at the prolonged end, from contemplating void: by void, by supreme power — to voidness she goes, O Bhairavī.
sanskrit_cite: praṇavādisamuccārāt plutānte śūnyabhāvānāt | śūnyayā parayā śaktyā śūnyatām eti bhairavi

plain_english: Of any letter whatsoever, the beginning and end should be contemplated: by void, become void, that man becomes void-formed.
sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyāpi varṇasya pūrvāntāv anubhāvayet | śūnyayā śūnyabhūto 'sau śūnyākāraḥ pumān bhavet
